description:
Thinking about buying a natural stone floor?

Before you spend hundreds or thousands of pounds on the floor itself, spend ten quid on getting the decisions right.

I’ve spent years supplying, laying, repairing and looking after natural stone floors. I’ve seen the good jobs, the bad jobs, the expensive mistakes and the things that nobody thinks to ask until it’s too late.

So I put together the guide I wish somebody had given me before I started.

Everything I Wish Somebody Had Told Me Before I Bought My Stone Floor is 30 pages of practical, straight-talking advice about:

• choosing the right stone for your house
• limestone, porcelain, terracotta and marble
• measuring and allowing for waste
• getting the floor underneath properly prepared
• underfloor heating
• planning the layout before you start
• laying and grouting
• sealing and cleaning
• repairing and renovating existing stone
• choosing the right installer
• avoiding common mistakes and expensive surprises

There isn’t a complicated formula to it. Natural stone isn’t something you need to be frightened of.

It’s about understanding what you’re buying, asking the right questions and making sensible decisions before the first piece of stone goes down.

It’s £10 and you get the PDF instantly after purchase.
